reviews.text: Good service. Especially good when the vet speak Swedish.
Friendly and correct service appropriate to the situation

Very nice and knowledgeable staff. I had my cat sterilized and vaccinated at the same time. The price was lower than I thought. Everything was clearly explained what was being done and what to expect after the surgery. I definitely recommend this place and will definitely shop here again.

Had a pretty seamless experience.
Took my dog for a castration, all went smoothly

I would give 0 stars if I could. Funding and unnecessary tests. In addition, it was claimed, for example, that my dog ​​could not be given any antibiotic other than amoxicillin for a urinary tract problem. This is not true! A decent doctor elsewhere gave other medications. They claim at every appointment that the teeth need to be treated in a 1500 euro operation. The worst thing was that I was ordered out of the reception room during the animal's intraocular pressure measurement, because they said the dog suffers from it and the owner should not be watching. I regret ever setting foot in this clinic. My dog ​​started feeling great when he got out of Evidensia's clutches.

The senior cat first had a health check and later had tartar removed. The old cat was scared to be put to sleep, but the procedure went well. The staff has also been nice and everything has been communicated clearly. The prices were explained before the procedure.

I am really disappointed with the service of this vet. During the visit, it seemed like they were charging me forcibly, and the final bill included additional charges that were not mentioned or explained in advance. A short visit of about 10 minutes could cost hundreds of euros. This seems unfair and unreliable.

I think the customer should have the right to know in advance what they are paying for and why, without being charged for services that were not even there. I cannot recommend this place to others because in my experience, the operation was not transparent.

I do not recommend this place to anyone! I took my cat to the doctor last year because there was blood in the urine, they supposedly did an ultrasound (apparently on the hair because the hair had not been shaved) and blood tests and it was not noticed that the cat had urinary stones. The same problem happened again and I took the cat to the right vet where it was immediately determined that the cat had urinary stones, one 1 cm in size (stones this big are only found in dogs) it takes longer than 4 months for a stone of that size to form and the other 1/2cm in size. The cat had to have surgery to remove the stones, if Evidensia had done the proper tests, the matter could have been treated without surgery and without causing unnecessary pain to the cat..

Reply to the comment below: I contacted you immediately after the incident and received a rude response from you that "contact the Finnish Food Authority's animal unit and ask for a statement from there." The price would have been 250€ after all the other costs 😳So keep your jacks 🙀
A really pleasant and good experience for both the dog and the owner. We underwent an extensive health check-up and vaccinations.
It was our first time at Evidensia. We had a good experience with the place, the staff and the care. We were given instructions and our questions were answered expertly. Thank you!

I would like to thank the veterinary clinic for the excellent service! The doctor was very friendly and knowledgeable, and he treated my cat with great warmth. I felt very well taken care of during the entire visit. I can definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for reliable and professional veterinary services. Thank you again for the excellent care!
Got an appointment quickly, good doctor and knowledgeable and nice nurse.

They were very good at treating cat patients and had a lot of knowledge about cat diseases. In addition, the visit was a great experience. I plan to do more business with this Evidensia in the future than with the one I used to do business with.

At least we have always had wonderful helpers. Every time we have left feeling relieved. And even though it seems like things happen to us, they still manage to smile and take care of both the dog and the owner. Even the cats, although they seem to end up at the reception less often. Over 15 years already.❤️🐻☀️ …
